en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5604 - Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The shares of inheritance were set at six portions and do not exceed that because the human being was created from six elements,
as stated in the words of Allah (swt), the Majestic:
'And indeed, We created man from an extract of clay.' (Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:12).
Another reason is that the inheritors who always inherit and are never excluded are six: the two parents, the son, the daughter, the husband, and the wife."
